data.name: Vijayan
data.gender_notes: Vijayan is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Vijayan is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Vijaya’, which means victory. The name is commonly used in Hindu culture, especially among the Tamil and Malayali communities. It is a powerful and evocative name, suggesting strength, courage, and triumph. The name Vijayan carries the meaning “Victorious” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Tamil, Malayalam. Parents who choose Vijayan usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vijayan is a name that resonates with the divine energy of victory and triumph. It is a reminder that no matter what challenges we face in life, we have the inner strength and courage to overcome them. The name is also associated with the Hindu god Vijay, who represents victory and triumph.
data.etymology: Vijayan belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vijayan total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.
